annotations.title: Get the Go Rocket plan checkout link

description: Returns a checkout link when credits are needed: the monthly plan, or a one-time top-up for an existing subscriber. Existing account? Call sign_in, then create_video to use its credits first. For a new account, call this once the sample is ready. No money is charged by this tool: payment happens only after opening the checkout and confirming payment. After payment, sign in through this connector to create videos in the same chat.

inputSchema.description: claim_token is required for a signed-out sample checkout.
